notes.title: 'Dark Water : Slime Invader' will be released.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36801428/609cee8b41d94458d1b7213caade8a0949db8291.png[/img]

Hello Everyone,

'Dark Water : Slime Invader' will be officially released on March 18.

If you send us your good opinions, we'll try our best to develop into a better game!

Celebrating the launch of 'Dark Water : Slime Invader', a 10% discount will be offered!
Don't miss this opportunity!

Thank you.
